description: The 2012 Australian Earthquake Hazard Map is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This document presents a new set of earthquake hazard maps for consideration in the next revision of the earthquake loading code AS1170. 4 "Structural design actions: Part 4 Earthquake actions in Australia". The earthquake catalogue used here includes events up until 2011. It is a combined version of several catalogues provided by external agencies. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Earth Sciences, GA Publication, Published_External, Record, WMS. It offers 6 resource(s) in html, pdf, wms. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
